items.title: Senior counsel Gopal Sankaranarayanan withdraws from Delhi protest cases before Supreme Court
items.summary: Senior Advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan has withdrawn from seven matters concerning the Delhi protests before the Supreme Court following repeated interruptions and the alleged snatching of his microphone during Thursday's hearing. A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi on Thursday heard around 46 petitions concerning alleged police brutality, unlawful detentions, restrictions on public movement, journalists' rights and the denotification of Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site. When Bar & Bench reached out to Sankaranarayanan to confirm his decision to withdraw from the cases, the senior counsel said, "The bench failed to control the court. I cannot continue like this. Dignity of the court is more important." Sankaranarayanan expressed concern over the lack of order during the hearing, particularly the manner in which matters were taken up without following their serial numbers. He added that preserving the dignity and decorum of the Court was more important than continuing his appearances in the cases. items.title: FDI, fundraising and filings: Practical answers to questions every founder, CFO and in-house counsel should be asking
items.summary: In this Leading Questions piece, Sheena Ogra and Avantika Shukla address some of the key questions surrounding corporate compliances and FEMA compliance that organisations need to keep in mind in the context of fundraising and foreign investment. As India's startup and investment ecosystem continues to evolve, regulatory compliance has become far more than a post-closing formality. Any non-compliance in maintaining secretarial records or failure to undertake necessary filings with regulatory authorities can not only expose an organisation to hefty penalties but, where the organisation is looking to raise funds, can also invariably affect investor confidence, thereby causing delays in closing a transaction and, in certain instances, even affect the overall goodwill of such an organisation. Therefore, in this piece, we address the legal and practical considerations that a company should keep in mind from a compliance standpoint to minimise potential risks and strengthen its focus on being compliant before, during and after a fundraise or equity infusion.
